### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

SONiC currently uses 3 versions of libyang: 1.0.73, 1.0.184, and 2.1.148. All are end of life and potentially have security issues. The current release is 3.12.2 and that is what we are targeting here.

There are also numerous libyang related bugs that have been "worked around" in SONiC due to the shortcomings of libyang1. Hopefully upgrading to a modern version will resolve such issues.

3 libyang versions

### Proposed Behavior

single libyang version

resolution.title: [rules] Remove libyang1, keep only libyang3
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it

SONiC has been migrating from libyang1 (`libyang`, `libyang-cpp`, `python3-yang`) to libyang3 (`libyang3`, `python3-libyang`) incrementally, building both in parallel during the transition. This is the **last** PR: with every consumer now on libyang3, it removes libyang1 entirely along with the transitional scaffolding that kept the two from colliding — the `libyang3-dev-done` ordering shim and the post-FRR `UNINSTALLS` of `libyang3-dev` (needed only because `libyang1-dev` and `libyang3-dev` can't be installed on the build host at once).

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22385 — this is the last PR to complete the fix.

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

- Migrated the remaining consumer `rules/*.mk` and platform rules that still pulled libyang1 packages (`LIBYANG`, `LIBYANG_CPP`, `LIBYANG_PY3`, `LIBYANG_DEV`, `LIBYANG*_DBG`) to the libyang3 equivalents (`LIBYANG3`, `LIBYANG3_PY3`, `LIBYANG3_DEV`, `LIBYANG3_DBG`). The Python binding moves from `LIBYANG_PY3` (`python3-yang`, libyang1 C++ wrapper) to `LIBYANG3_PY3` (`python3-libyang`, libyang3 direct bindings); `LIBYANG_CPP` has no libyang3 equivalent and is dropped.
- Removed the `libyang3-dev-done` coexistence shim (`rules/libyang3-dev-done.{mk,dep}` and the `$(LIBYANG)_PHONIES` hook). It existed only to order builds before the conflicting `libyang1-dev` was installed; with no libyang1 consumer the constraint is gone.
- Stopped uninstalling `libyang3-dev` after the FRR build (`$(FRR)_UNINSTALLS`). It was the partner of the coexistence shim; with no `libyang1-dev` to install, stripping `libyang3-dev` broke sonic-gnmi's CGo build (`fatal error: libyang/libyang.h: No such file or directory`).
- Deleted the libyang1 build itself: `rules/libyang.{mk,dep}` and `src/libyang`.
- **Deleted the SONiC-built `libpcre3`** (`rules/libpcre3.{mk,dep}` and `src/libpcre3`). This custom PCRE **8.x** build existed *solely* as a runtime dependency of libyang1, which linked the legacy PCRE3. libyang3 links **PCRE2** (`libpcre2-8-0`, already provided by the Debian base), so no SONiC-built libpcre3 is needed. With libyang1 gone, nothing in the build graph `DEPENDS`/`RDEPENDS` on `LIBPCRE3` or any of its derived packages (`LIBPCRE16_3`, `LIBPCRE32_3`, `LIBPCRECPP0V5`, `LIBPCRE3_DEV`, `LIBPCRE3_DBG`) — it was fully orphaned.
  - **Note for reviewers:** this removes only SONiC's *custom rebuild* of PCRE 8.39. Dockers and slave images that `apt-get install libpcre3` continue to pull the **Debian distro** package (`2:8.39-15`, note the epoch) from the base repos — a different version string than the SONiC build, and unaffected by this change. The existing `versions-deb-*` lock entries for `libpcre3` reference that distro package and remain valid.
- Cleaned up stale libyang1 references: dropped the libyang1 **and `libpcre3`** debs from the `sonic-yang-models` install line in `sonic_debian_extension.j2`, and removed `/src/libyang/` from `CODEOWNERS`. The `libpcre3_*.deb` glob on that install line was only there to satisfy libyang1; once libpcre3 stopped being built it became a dangling reference that broke image assembly with `cp: cannot stat 'target/debs/trixie/libpcre3_*.deb': No such file or directory`.

#### How to verify it

- `make configure PLATFORM=<vendor>` followed by a full image build completes; libyang1 debs (`libyang_*`, `libyang-cpp_*`, `python3-yang_*`) and the SONiC-built `libpcre3_*` debs are no longer produced or installed.
- `grep -rn 'LIBYANG[^3]'` over `rules/` and the build templates returns no libyang1 make-variable references; `git grep LIBPCRE3` returns no SONiC build rules (only distro `versions-deb-*` lock entries remain).
- sonic-gnmi / sonic-mgmt-common (CVL) build successfully — `libyang/libyang.h` remains present at FRR-and-later build stages.

#### Which release branch to backport (provide reason below if selected)

- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [ ] 202505
- [ ] 202511

#### Tested branch (Please provide the tested image version)

- [ ]
- [ ]

#### Description for the changelog

Remove libyang1; migrate all remaining consumers to libyang3 and delete the libyang1 build, the SONiC-built libpcre3 (a libyang1-only dependency), and the coexistence shims.

#### Link to config_db schema for YANG module changes

N/A — build-system only; no YANG model or config_db schema changes.

🦦
